params.columns: k UInt64, a UInt64, b UInt64, c UInt64, d UInt64
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS a, a % 1000 AS b, k * 7 AS c, intDiv(k, 3) AS d FROM numbers({rows})

description: Paced natural merges: one 1000-row insert every 0.25 s for 10 min, then a wait until no merge has run for 60 s. A shortened amplification-run.2h: validates the amplification rule and, on local, tests whether the 1-s write peak over the mean is a constant.
